scientific_question: Does the final frozen ReM+SWITCH_LINE+K2 production pipeline improve independent Voynich statistics beyond the cipher alone?

inputs.robust_rule: for each metric and arm, take the worse normalized Voynich loss across ATOMIC/LITERAL after median aggregation over production replicates

simulation.metric_seed: 42000 + replicate; identical for CIPHER_ONLY and FINAL_PIPELINE and both representations within a replicate

pipeline.reset: read canonical reset choice from FINAL_PIPELINE_REFERENCE.json generated mechanically from frozen selection rule
pipeline.ordering: read canonical PRE/POST choice from FINAL_PIPELINE_REFERENCE.json generated mechanically from frozen selection rule
pipeline.sensitivity: if reset or order is unresolved, run the predeclared alternate sensitivity arm(s), but never replace the canonical arm based on Phase-9 scores

confirmatory_panel.per_document_arm_loss: median of the 24 robust per-metric losses
confirmatory_panel.family_gain: for each locked 4-metric family, per-document median(cipher_loss-final_loss), then median over documents

vms_baseline.construction: build once from immutable enriched_records.pkl grouped into real lines by (folio,line_no), using the frozen 85-metric code and seed 42 before synthetic scoring
vms_baseline.stored_fields: 24 panel metrics, existing tolerances, VMS boundary diagnostics, input/code blob ids

line_boundary_holdout.matching_rule: for every boundary between consecutive lines in the same folio where the preceding line has >=2 tokens and next line >=1, cross pair=(prev[-1],next[0]); matched within pair=(prev[-2],prev[-1])
metrics: mean I(cross tokens equal)-mean I(matched within tokens equal)
mean absolute word-length difference(cross)-mean absolute word-length difference(matched within)
line_boundary_holdout.synthetic_rule: apply exactly the same endpoint-matched rule to consecutive W10 synthetic lines

primary_adjudication.CONFIRMATORY_BROAD_IMPROVEMENT: lower 95% bootstrap CI of median document gain >0, >=5/6 family median gains >0, and no family median gain < -0.5
primary_adjudication.CONFIRMATORY_NO_GAIN: upper 95% bootstrap CI of median document gain <=0

execution_guard.rule: verify sealed panel, selection rule, Phase-8 final reference, metric-code blob and VMS-record blob before building VMS baseline or scoring ReM; no Q scorer is used in Phase 9
execution_guard.workflow_launch: only after Phase-8 replication guard passes
